purpose: Test whether admission-visible link externality can improve a strong sparse-DAG baseline without losing Decode batching.
primary_comparison: priced versus gated on C1_multi, paired by seed and trace
if_development_fails: Stop. Report the negative result; do not tune the coefficient on these seeds or claim closure.
if_development_passes: Freeze a separate formal protocol and run unseen seeds with full-length windows.
limits: Discrete-event simulation; two short development seeds are only a gate, not final evidence.
